facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹1.72 lakh cr, +12% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹33,471 cr, +8% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹44,179 cr (+21% YoY), PAT ₹6,547 cr (+57% YoY), operating margin 19.2%.
Revenue has compounded at 8% over 10 years, 13% over 5 and 7% over 3.
Profit has compounded slower than revenue over 3 years (-1% vs 7%): growth is costing margin.
Quarterly revenue growth has accelerated over the last four quarters: −5% → +23% → +8% → +21% YoY.
Operating margin is steady at 19.2% (18.0% a year ago).
Annual operating margin has ranged from 22% to 33% over five years; the latest year (22%) sits at the bottom of that range.
Borrowings are ₹15,668 cr against equity of ₹1.27 lakh cr: debt/equity 0.12× (was 0.07× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 41.9× over the last twelve months.
Capital work-in-progress is ₹15,978 cr, 17% of fixed assets — a large build-out not yet earning.
The cash conversion cycle is 31 days, little changed from 34 in Mar 2023.
Promoters hold 61.1%, −2.0 pp over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹1.68 lakh cr of operating cash came from ₹1.97 lakh cr of operating profit: 85% conversion; against PAT of ₹1.53 lakh cr that is 1.1×.
Free cash flow was negative in 0 of the last 5 years; cumulative ₹97,728 cr, latest year ₹30,783 cr.
Capex ran at 7% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹12,432 cr (averaged 10% over the three years before).
